description:
Save the test plan to specs/. Give it structured, as in Playwright: name, overview, suites (name, seedFile) with tests (name, target file) and steps (perform + expect per step); add the elements you found (name + locator) and any gaps. It is written as Markdown in a fixed layout. Free-form planContent is still accepted.

Every saved plan is a draft ("Status: draft"): show it to the user and wait for their review. The generator refuses a draft plan; when the user approves it, call planner_approve_plan with their words.

locator.description: Stable locator, preferably the test id, e.g. "[data-testid=\"search-input\"]"

name.description: What the element is, e.g. "Search field"
Title of the plan, e.g. "Shopping cart and checkout"

overview.description: What the application or feature does, in a few sentences

name.description: Name of the suite (a feature or flow)

expect.description: Expected results of this step, e.g. 'The cart button shows "1 items"'

name: planner_save_plan
